name_input: JRG Automotive Industries India Pvt Ltd
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug: jrg-automotive-industries-india-private-limited) shows a real outbound row: "2026-02-23 | JRG AUTOMOTIVE INDUSTRIES INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | JCB DO BRASIL LTDA . | 332/G4667 PIPE COVER RH ABI- | BALLABGARH ICD INFBD6, India | Santos, Brazil | 84314390 | 9929053" — i.e. dated 2026-02-23, destination Santos, Brazil, HS 84314390, B/L 9929053. Page header states "Total Shipments 306 Records detected", "Trading Partners 15", "Ports 21", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-23". Counter vs rows actually seen: page claims 306 total shipments; only 5 individual rows were rendered in the free view (1 export to Brazil + 4 import rows from China), so the 306 figure is a platform counter, not verified row-by-row. Note the declared HS 392690 does not match the observed export HS 84314390 (parts of boring/sinking machinery) nor the observed import HS codes 87089900, 85158010, 39033000.
domestic_evidence: No domestic supply record retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender participation and annual-report splits were not obtained: web_search backend returned "Connection refused" for every query, and registry/aggregator pages (thecompanycheck.com, volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. ImportKey rows show only cross-border movements (imports from Dongguan/Taizhou/Wuhan/Shanghai, China; export to Santos, Brazil) — no India-domestic consignee or GST-based supply line is visible on that page.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by a dated customs row with B/L number, not by a website claim: 2026-02-23, Ballabgarh ICD -> Santos, Brazil, HS 84314390, B/L 9929053, buyer JCB DO BRASIL LTDA. The company is an active two-way trader/manufacturer: it also imports door-trim/moulded parts and plastic granule (HS 87089900, 39033000) from Chinese mould suppliers, consistent with an automotive interior-trim manufacturer supplying JCB-type equipment programmes. Declared HS 392690 (other articles of plastics) is not what the customs records show; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the HS should be corrected to the observed 84314390 for the export line (and 87089900 for the automotive trim imports). PAN AASCS3288F and the claimed Gujarat state were not verified in this pass; the ImportKey address field reads "DSM 410, DLF TOWERS, SHIVAJI MARG" (Delhi), which conflicts with the claimed Gujarat state — worth a registry check. Revenue and export volume: null, not public in the free views. Domestic (India) supply evidence: not found in this pass — stated as unknown, not as 'conditionally accepted'.
